## What's New in Quote 2.0.1

* Every quote now has 3 to 5 hand-picked tags, shown in a single tidy row on the daily quote
* Tags are translated in the German app, and quotes without an author have tags too
* Headers, tab switchers and buttons float above the list, so cards scroll underneath and fade out instead of being cut off
* Removed the "A thought worth keeping" subtitle from the daily quote
* Shorter onboarding that fits on one screen, with its own page for the home screen widget
* Cards resize smoothly when switching between original and translation
